_comment:
'When this defends alone, prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn.'

Release notes settle WHEN: 'When this defends' is event-based, checked at the moment it is added as a defender - so TRIGGERED + ON_DEFEND, which engine._dsl_defend_listener (engine.py:1629-1635) dispatches to the defending card object itself, meaning no source-scoping condition is needed. 'Alone' is DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT amount=1 comparison=eq, evaluated at triggered-layer resolution against combat.defending_cards - matching notes 3/4 (a co-declared defender suppresses the trigger) and note 2 (a defense reaction added AFTER resolution cannot revoke it: the condition was checked once and the prevention shield persists).

AMBIGUITY flagged: note 1's final sentence ('It will trigger regardless if there are already other defending cards on that active chain link') could be read as 'an add-by-effect (Pulsewave Harpoon) triggers even alongside surviving co-defenders'. This draft keeps the printed text's plain reading - alone AT the moment it defends - under which that sentence describes defenders added and since removed earlier in the link. If adopters read the note the other way, loosen/drop the DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT condition; nothing else changes.

PREVENT_DAMAGE verified live: handler (effect_types.py:5152-5215) reads amount, filters damage events to ev.target_player_id == controller, absorbs up to N then consumes (one-shot). One accepted imprecision: ReplacementEffect (effects.py:121-134) has no turn-expiry field, so if the attack is blocked outright the unused shield survives past 'this turn' and could absorb 1 damage on a later turn. Canonical primitive, fails in the player's favour rarely; flagged for reviewers rather than worked around.

No printed keywords, so no conditional-keyword machinery applies.
